verdict.rationale: Qodo produces AI-generated insights from a team's code and PR data: severity-ranked findings that explain what, why, and how to fix, with fixes it can apply directly. It also generates full-codebase PR summaries, automatic risk classification, related-PR relevance, in-PR chat, rule generation mined from PR history, and a history of findings and codebase health. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and stronger evidence of insights surfaced in the Qodo portal itself (most appear inside the Git provider's PRs, and codebase-health views are only briefly described).
